china_race_dynamics.text: So I think we should get out of the fearmongering and know that we’re not going to govern by fear in the United States Congress,” Steube continued. “We are going to govern by common sense and good policy, and the president has made it very clear politically where he stands on this issue. So, Congress, even trying to act on this, the President is not going to sign any bill that Congress may pass in the next three months as we go into the midterms, so I think we need to be focused on National Security first and ensure that we win the AI race as it relates to China.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the focus should be national security first and winning the AI race with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The competition-priority endorsement is clear, though the surrounding remarks about fearmongering are less specific.
